chk_bank_statement_lines_amounts.name: chk_bank_statement_lines_amounts

chk_bank_statement_lines_ready.name: chk_bank_statement_lines_ready
chk_bank_statement_lines_ready.value:
"bank_statement_lines"."status" <> 'ready'
        OR (
          "bank_statement_lines"."txn_date" IS NOT NULL
          AND "bank_statement_lines"."narration" IS NOT NULL
          AND trim("bank_statement_lines"."narration") <> ''
          AND ("bank_statement_lines"."withdrawal_amount" IS NOT NULL) <> ("bank_statement_lines"."deposit_amount" IS NOT NULL)
          AND ("bank_statement_lines"."withdrawal_amount" IS NULL OR "bank_statement_lines"."withdrawal_amount" > 0)
          AND ("bank_statement_lines"."deposit_amount" IS NULL OR "bank_statement_lines"."deposit_amount" > 0)
        )

chk_bank_statement_lines_imported.name: chk_bank_statement_lines_imported
chk_bank_statement_lines_imported.value:
(
          "bank_statement_lines"."status" = 'imported'
          AND "bank_statement_lines"."transaction_id" IS NOT NULL
          AND "bank_statement_lines"."imported_at" IS NOT NULL
        )
        OR (
          "bank_statement_lines"."status" <> 'imported'
          AND "bank_statement_lines"."transaction_id" IS NULL
        )

chk_bank_statements_dates.name: chk_bank_statements_dates
chk_bank_statements_dates.value: "bank_statements"."statement_from" IS NULL OR "bank_statements"."statement_to" IS NULL OR "bank_statements"."statement_from" <= "bank_statements"."statement_to"

chk_transactions_recurring_link.name: chk_transactions_recurring_link
chk_transactions_recurring_link.value: ("transactions"."recurring_id" IS NULL) = ("transactions"."recurring_due" IS NULL) AND ("transactions"."recurring_id" IS NULL) = ("transactions"."recurring_settled" IS NULL)

chk_transactions_currency_rules.name: chk_transactions_currency_rules
chk_transactions_currency_rules.value:
("transactions"."original_currency" = 'INR' 
          AND "transactions"."exchange_rate" IS NULL 
          AND "transactions"."exchange_rate_date" IS NULL 
          AND "transactions"."rate_source" IS NULL 
          AND "transactions"."amount_inr" = "transactions"."original_amount")
        OR
        ("transactions"."original_currency" = 'USD' 
          AND "transactions"."exchange_rate" IS NOT NULL 
          AND "transactions"."exchange_rate" > 0 
          AND "transactions"."exchange_rate_date" IS NOT NULL 
          AND "transactions"."rate_source" IS NOT NULL 
          AND "transactions"."rate_source" = 'manual' 
          AND "transactions"."amount_inr" > 0)

chk_transactions_type_requirements.name: chk_transactions_type_requirements
chk_transactions_type_requirements.value:
("transactions"."type_id" = 1 AND "transactions"."client_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR
        ("transactions"."type_id" = 2 AND "transactions"."description" IS NOT NULL AND trim("transactions"."description") <> '')
